title: Branches & Pull Requests
subtitle: Branch, push, open a PR
description: Part 4 of Git & GitHub — the collaboration loop: branch off main, push your branch, and open a pull request like real teams do.
learningOutcomes: Create a new git branch for a change
Understand merge vs keeping the PR open for review

goals.title: Create a branch
goals.goal: Create and switch to a new branch for a small change.
goals.coachAsk: Help me create a new git branch for a small change and switch to it. Keep the name simple — look at my Terminal if it's open.
goals.doneWhen: A new branch is checked out (git branch / status shows it).
tips: Something like fix-readme is a great name
Stay off main/master for the experiment

goals.title: Commit on the branch
goals.goal: Make a small change and commit it on your branch.
goals.coachAsk: Help me make a tiny change on this branch and commit it — same idea as before, just on the feature branch.
goals.doneWhen: At least one commit exists on the new branch.

goals.title: Push the branch
goals.goal: Push your branch to GitHub so it exists remotely.
goals.coachAsk: Help me push this branch to GitHub so I can open a pull request next.
goals.doneWhen: The branch exists on the GitHub remote (push succeeded or branch visible on GitHub).
tips: First push of a branch often needs -u / upstream setup — coach whatever the tool suggests

goals.title: Open a pull request
goals.goal: Open a pull request from your branch into the default branch.
goals.coachAsk: Help me open a pull request on GitHub from my branch. Point at what I should use and explain what the PR is asking for in one casual sentence.
goals.doneWhen: A pull request page or create-PR flow is open for the branch.
tips: GitHub often shows a Compare & pull request banner after push
Draft PRs are fine for learning

goals.title: Know what happens next
goals.goal: Understand merge vs leaving the PR open — and optionally merge if it's your own practice repo.
goals.coachAsk: I've got a pull request open — briefly explain merge vs leaving it for review, and point at the merge control if I want to finish on my own practice repo.
goals.doneWhen: The learner confirmed they understand the next step, or they merged the practice PR.
tips: On a throwaway practice repo, merging is fine
On someone else's project, don't merge without permission
